P1Q-18.summary: full instrument-adequacy criterion 3 u_R > 0.02 |I_e,collector| on the RF-ON ICP45_CAPACITY candidate record; matched RF-OFF record uses the floor-based statistical/fractional closure with I_scale,min; a fractional-only RF-OFF resolution failure is NOT_EVALUATED_INSTRUMENT, not automatically an exclusion
